T-A.name: Shell & IA Lock
T-A.objective: Make the executable app shell canonical, testable, and free of active legacy IA seams.

T-B.name: Local Data Foundation
T-B.objective: Harden domain, SwiftData, repositories, migrations, and local data integrity.

T-C.name: Private Life Runtime Proof
T-C.objective: Prove the local deterministic runtime moat with executable tests, replay, receipts, and correction loops.

T-D.name: Apple Platform Depth
T-D.objective: Expand safe Apple-native depth through intents, search, Handoff, background maintenance, widgets, and continuity gates.

T-E.name: Trust, Accessibility, Release Lock
T-E.objective: Lock accessibility, privacy, performance, release, and repo-governance gates with device proof.

issues.title: Canonical root shell and app chrome integrity
issues.problem: Root shell expectations and rendered shell affordances are not fully aligned.
issues.implementation: Create one canonical shell path for tab host, contextual header rail, continuity ribbon, global capture entry, overlay host, safe-area behavior, accessibility identifiers, and UI smoke tests.
issues.acceptance: All five tabs render through one canonical shell path and shell UI tests pass.
issues.validation: xcodegen generate; xcodebuild test -scheme Ambitions -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'; scripts/validate_flagship_remediation.sh
issues.rollback: Keep prior TabView shell as a temporary compatibility fallback until tests pass.

issues.title: Slice AppContainer into bounded capabilities
issues.problem: The app container is too dense and risks becoming a service locator.
issues.implementation: Split capabilities into shell, runtime, persistence, platform, user system, and feature factory slices. Feature screens should receive only the required slice.
issues.acceptance: Feature construction is inspectable and no screen imports the full global container unnecessarily.
issues.validation: Build, dependency review artifact, affected feature tests.
issues.rollback: Keep AppContainer as a facade delegating to sliced capabilities.

issues.title: Retire active legacy IA route seams
issues.problem: Legacy route language can leak into active product routes and weaken canonical IA clarity.
issues.implementation: Move legacy route compatibility into documented boundary adapters only. Active APIs must use Today, Goals, Capture, Time, and You.
issues.acceptance: No active user-facing route or app intent exposes deprecated top-level object names except hidden compatibility shims.
issues.validation: Canon grep/lint, navigation tests, App Intent route tests.
issues.rollback: Preserve hidden deep-link compatibility mappings.

issues.title: Shell visual QA and preview matrix
issues.problem: Shell polish needs device-visible proof across sizes, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and dark/OLED states.
issues.implementation: Add preview matrices and screenshot hooks for all top-level tabs and major shell states.
issues.acceptance: Each tab has preview coverage and screenshot proof path.
issues.validation: Preview compile, UI screenshot smoke, proof artifact.
issues.rollback: Keep preview data isolated from production models.

issues.title: Decontaminate life-context domain fixtures
issues.problem: Domain fixtures may contain off-domain or stale scenario vocabulary.
issues.implementation: Replace non-Ambitions fixtures with neutral, privacy-safe Ambitions-native personas. Remove obsolete enum references and fixture bleed.
issues.acceptance: No off-domain fixture vocabulary remains in compiled domain source.
issues.validation: Build, fixture lint, runtime scenario tests.
issues.rollback: Archive old fixtures only in docs, never active source.

issues.title: SwiftData temporal and enum type-safety pass
issues.problem: Persistence can become fragile if dates, states, and enums rely on raw strings.
issues.implementation: Convert persisted temporal fields to Date where appropriate and isolate raw enum storage to tested adapters.
issues.acceptance: Core persisted entities no longer depend on ad hoc string ordering.
issues.validation: Migration harness, repository round-trip tests, deterministic ordering tests.
issues.rollback: Add v1-to-v2 migration adapters and backup export path.

issues.title: Normalize persistence away from blob-first reads
issues.problem: Snapshot blobs should not be the ordinary read path for key product objects.
issues.implementation: Normalize primary fields for goals, steps, receipts, context, closure, recovery, and time placement. Keep snapshots for audit/export boundaries.
issues.acceptance: Today, Goals, Time, and You reads do not require decoding whole object snapshots.
issues.validation: Repository query tests, performance baseline, storage comparison.
issues.rollback: Maintain snapshot fallback for one migration cycle.

issues.title: Explicit schema migration and store recovery system
issues.problem: The store needs explicit migration, recovery, corruption handling, and proof artifacts.
issues.implementation: Add schema versioning, migration plans, seeded historical stores, corruption handling, recovery mode, and migration receipts.
issues.acceptance: Every persisted model revision has a tested upgrade path.
issues.validation: Migration matrix, seeded old-store upgrade tests, corrupt-store simulation.
issues.rollback: Export backup before migration and support explicit safe reset.

issues.title: Repository query performance and deterministic ordering gates
issues.problem: Core local reads need reliable ordering and bounded query work.
issues.implementation: Add deterministic sorting, query limits, large fixtures, and budget gates for repository calls.
issues.acceptance: Core repository reads have deterministic ordering and measured budgets.
issues.validation: Repository benchmark tests and deterministic result snapshots.
issues.rollback: Keep old repository methods as deprecated internal helpers.

issues.title: Structured life context and Memory Lens data basis
issues.problem: You and Memory Lens need structured, editable, provenance-aware local data.
issues.implementation: Back memory/profile/life-context display with structured local records, provenance, confidence, edit/reset controls, and privacy-safe indexing.
issues.acceptance: User can inspect, edit, reset, and understand local life-context records.
issues.validation: You feature tests, reset tests, provenance rendering tests, privacy redaction tests.
issues.rollback: Keep projected summaries as display fallback.

issues.title: Same-intent different-context runtime proof harness
issues.problem: The core moat must be proven in code, not just docs.
issues.implementation: Create fixtures with same goal/intent but different local contexts and assert deterministically different Start here outputs with receipts.
issues.acceptance: Executable proof shows different recommended steps from different local contexts.
issues.validation: Runtime proof tests, explanation diff artifact, replay artifact.
issues.rollback: Keep existing Today selection logic as fallback.

issues.title: Deterministic planner rule-engine upgrade
issues.problem: Planning heuristics need to be deeper than lexical or shallow priority matching.
issues.implementation: Build inspectable local rules using context vectors, user defaults, closure evidence, time fit, confidence, fallback reasons, and deterministic traces.
issues.acceptance: Planner output is local, deterministic, inspectable, and context-aware.
issues.validation: Golden plan tests, edge-case fixtures, no-network assertion, explanation trace tests.
issues.rollback: Keep current planner as deterministic fallback.

issues.title: Today runtime replay and receipt inspector
issues.problem: Start here recommendations need inspectable proof and replay evidence.
issues.implementation: Add receipt/proof drawer with inputs, freshness, local-only source boundaries, time fit, alternatives rejected, and closure/recovery effects.
issues.acceptance: Every Start here recommendation has inspectable proof and replay test coverage.
issues.validation: Today UI tests, runtime replay tests, receipt snapshot tests.
issues.rollback: Expose inspector behind internal flag until stable.

issues.title: User correction loop for runtime trust
issues.problem: A personal life OS needs corrections that change future behavior without cloud dependence.
issues.implementation: Add correction flows for wrong reason, wrong context, wrong capacity, unavailable, still counts, blocked, waiting, and recovery needed.
issues.acceptance: Corrections change future local recommendations and generate receipts.
issues.validation: Correction loop tests, no-network tests, accessibility flow tests.
issues.rollback: Persist corrections separately until behavior is proven.

issues.title: Deep App Intents action surface
issues.problem: App Intents should do more than open routes.
issues.implementation: Add parameterized intents for capture, goal draft, open current step, start current step, guarded close step, show receipt, and inspect local knowledge.
issues.acceptance: Shortcuts can perform meaningful Ambitions-native actions with safety boundaries.
issues.validation: App Intent tests, phrase review, route execution tests.
issues.rollback: Disable public shortcut exposure until safety review passes.

issues.title: Spotlight and Handoff object reopening
issues.problem: Search and Handoff strategy should be implemented with privacy boundaries.
issues.implementation: Index safe summaries for goals, current step, receipts, and captures. Add Handoff reopening for active step and goal detail.
issues.acceptance: Apple-native reopening works without leaking sensitive private content.
issues.validation: Indexing tests, redaction tests, Handoff route tests.
issues.rollback: Gate indexing behind opt-in/internal flag.

issues.title: Optional CloudKit continuity decision gate
issues.problem: Continuity matters, but it cannot compromise local-first trust or launch stability.
issues.implementation: Create a decision gate for optional CloudKit with schema, conflict model, opt-in UX, off switch, privacy copy, and proof tests.
issues.acceptance: No sync implementation proceeds without signed-off privacy and migration strategy.
issues.validation: Architecture decision record, sync fixture plan, privacy review packet.
issues.rollback: Keep launch local-only if proof is not green.

issues.title: Background maintenance and notification reconciliation
issues.problem: The app needs coherent state after relaunch, day rollover, stale notifications, and interrupted sessions.
issues.implementation: Add background-safe reconciliation for day maintenance, notification schedule refresh, stale-step closure prompts, and receipt freshness.
issues.acceptance: Relaunch and day transitions preserve coherent Today state.
issues.validation: Clock travel tests, notification reconciliation tests, lifecycle UI tests.
issues.rollback: Gate background writes until read-only reconciliation is proven.

issues.title: Widget and Live Activity flagship expansion
issues.problem: External surfaces should feel like native Ambitions extensions, not demos.
issues.implementation: Expand widget families for current step, Today pressure, protected time, capture entry, and recovery state. Add Live Activity proof where appropriate.
issues.acceptance: Widgets and Live Activity states are Ambitions-native and validated.
issues.validation: Widget snapshots, ActivityKit update tests, lock screen review.
issues.rollback: Keep existing Next Step widget baseline.

issues.title: Accessibility proof matrix and gates
issues.problem: Accessibility needs device-backed proof across real surfaces.
issues.implementation: Create proof matrix for VoiceOver labels/order, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast, tap targets, non-color meaning, and cognitive clarity.
issues.acceptance: Accessibility status is evidence-backed for all five tabs and key flows.
issues.validation: Accessibility UI tests, manual audit packet, screenshot proof.
issues.rollback: Block release if any P0 accessibility gate is red.

issues.title: Device-truth QA and release candidate packet
issues.problem: Readiness proof must come from device and binary behavior.
issues.implementation: Create an RC packet requiring build output, simulator/device matrix, screenshots, accessibility evidence, migration proof, privacy manifest proof, and known limitation log.
issues.acceptance: No release can be green without device-backed evidence.
issues.validation: RC packet, UI tests, migration tests.
issues.rollback: Release remains blocked until packet is green.

issues.title: Privacy manifest and App Store declaration alignment
issues.problem: Privacy claims must match binary behavior, permissions, logs, indexing, and continuity choices.
issues.implementation: Audit permissions, network calls, logs, indexing, analytics/crash behavior, export/sync behavior, and generate privacy readiness artifact.
issues.acceptance: App Store privacy claims, privacy manifest, and code behavior are consistent.
issues.validation: Privacy lint, no-network runtime test, manifest review.
issues.rollback: Remove or gate any feature that cannot be honestly declared.

issues.title: Local observability and performance baselines
issues.problem: A local-first flagship needs measurable performance without leaking private data.
issues.implementation: Add local redacted logging, launch-time budget, repository query budget, runtime projection budget, and local diagnostic export.
issues.acceptance: Performance and diagnostics proof exists without private analytics collection.
issues.validation: Performance baseline script, log redaction tests, launch budget artifact.
issues.rollback: Diagnostics disabled by default until privacy review passes.

issues.title: Repo authority collapse and Codex automation manifest
issues.problem: Repo governance is strong but heavy; Codex needs fewer sharper authority paths.
issues.implementation: Create authority map, stale-doc detector, active batch manifest, train runner instructions, and Green/Yellow/Red proof reporting.
issues.acceptance: Codex can identify source truth, batch order, validation commands, proof artifacts, and rollback behavior.
issues.validation: Authority lint, stale-doc scan, manifest validation script.
issues.rollback: Never delete historical docs without archiving or explicit stale classification.
